description: A timeline for a whole roast dinner (Sunday roast, Christmas dinner or Thanksgiving), worked back from the serving time: when to take the meat out of the fridge, heat the oven, put it in, turn the oven up for the sides, and when each side goes on. Also lists what can be done the day before.

doneness.description: Optional. beef: rare, medium or well. lamb: pink or well.

main.description: The main roast. crown is a turkey crown.

method.description: Turkey only: uk (190°C) or usda (325°F). Defaults to usda when the weight is in lb.

serve_time.description: Serving time as HH:MM in 24-hour time, e.g. 14:00.

sides.description: Optional sides: roastPotatoes, yorkshires, pigsInBlankets, stuffing, rootVeg (roast parsnips and carrots), cauliflowerCheese, greens, carrots, breadSauce, mash, dressing (baked stuffing), greenBean (green bean casserole), sweetPotato (sweet potato casserole), macCheese, rolls, corn, cranberry, pie, gravy. Plain names such as "roast potatoes" work too.

weight.description: Weight of the meat, in the unit given by unit.

name: plan_roast_dinner
title: Plan a roast dinner
